name: posthog-js-full
description: Subpath entry point for the bundle that inlines the extensions PostHog otherwise loads at runtime: session replay, surveys, logs, exception autocapture, tracing headers, web vitals and dead clicks. It still installs the external script loader, so what it does not inline — product tours, conversations, the toolbar, remote config and the chat integrations — is still loaded from the CDN when used. Use posthog-js/full/no-external when no script may be loaded. Ships an ES module for bundlers and a CommonJS build for require. Types come from the canonical dist/module.d.ts: PostHog is a class with private members, so a duplicate declaration file would be a nominally incompatible type.
